info.name: Authorization Tokens Accounts fund reports - esg API
Get an Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Report

params.name: fundshareclassId
params.description: Unique identifier of a fund shareclass

params.name: analyst-rating
params.description: Include Morningstar Analyst Ratings data point in report

params.name: locale
params.description: Language and locale, for example, en-US

items.docs: Get an ESG Report for the fund shareclass specified in the `fundshareclassId` parameter.</br></br>To override the default value in the Accept-Language HTTP header, use the `locale` parameter. </br></br>In the `pageSize` parameter, you can specify the page size for the returned PDF. Page size options are `Letter` or `A4`.</br></br>If a report exists, a presigned URL from which you can download the PDF is returned in the response.
